Best match is dogwhistle/honest.py `_verify_history` (lines 175-195). It is the only candidate that does both things the request asks for. It raises if prereg_commit equals ledger_commit. It also requires `git diff --name-only` between those two commits to list only the public digest file. I did not check that honest.py is "two-arm".

Second is dogwhistle/visibility.py `_verify_history` (lines 191-205). It has the same signature and structure as honest.py but has neither check. It is the closest sibling to compare against.

dogwhistle/study.py `verify_history` (lines 314-332) and dogwhistle/heldout.py `verify_history` (lines 343-363) take a separate seal and ledger. They check ancestry, source bytes and anchor bytes. They do not reject equal commits or check which files changed. I did not check their other code.

Suggested 60-minute split:
- honest.py: 30 min. Confirm both checks and read tests/test_honest.py.
- visibility.py: 15 min. Confirm the gaps and read tests/test_visibility.py.
- heldout.py: 8 min.
- study.py: 7 min.
